name: research-data-extraction-assistant
description: Extract traceable, structured information from scientific research documents without inventing missing evidence.

interface.longDescription: Extract structured study characteristics, methods, populations, interventions, comparators, outcomes, statistical results, tables, figures, citations, limitations, and bias-related evidence from papers and research documents. Supports PICO/PICOS, single-study extraction, consistent multi-paper evidence tables, and JSON- or CSV-ready output. Every important value is tied to a source location when available; missing, unclear, and not-applicable values stay distinct. No external server, account connection, or database is required.
defaultPrompt: Extract the study design, population, interventions, outcomes, and main results from this paper.
Build a PICO table from this research document and cite source locations.
Create a consistent evidence table from these studies; flag missing or conflicting values.
